hardware: GM P10 (PcmHammer: no slave CPU; service numbers 12576463 / 12574976)

checksum.description: PcmHammer reports ChecksumSupport for P10, but no P10 layout is measured here. P01 corrector is refused on P10 OS IDs.

notes: Catalog entry from PcmHammer's public PcmInfo.cs. 512 KiB collides with P01: the OS ID decides. Identify/offline only.
sources: github.com/PcmHammer/PcmHammer @ 033cb039 Apps/PcmLibrary/Misc/PcmInfo.cs (case PcmType.P10 and OSID switch)

identify.source: P10 OS IDs from github.com/PcmHammer/PcmHammer @ 033cb039 Apps/PcmLibrary/Misc/PcmInfo.cs. This app reads the binary OS ID with the P01 layout (@0x504); that layout is not verified on a P10 image and there is no P10 dump in reference/.

read.source: PcmHammer uses Kernel-P10.bin @0xFFB800; this app has no P10 read path.

checksum.source: P01 corrector refused when the binary OS ID is a P10 OS. No P10 checksum layout in reference/.

seed_key.source: PcmInfo.cs KeyAlgorithm 66 (GM 2-byte table, reference/GmKeys.cs). Offline calculator only; never tried on a P10.

map_hints.source: No sourced P10 definitions in reference/.
